definitions.explanation: Acting without enough thought or caution. Often used in hindsight (うかつだった, 'that was careless of me') or as a warning (うかつに〜できない, 'one cannot casually ~').

examples.japanese: うかつなこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧うかつ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{信|しん}じて→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧しまった。
⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけ⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{我|われ}→我：30648_ware⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧うかつだった。
examples.english: Going out without locking the door was careless of me, I must admit.

notes:
Usually written in kana; the kanji are rare.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- うかつ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}せない→出す：01087_dasu⟧: one can't rashly get involved
- うかつなこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say something careless
- うかつだった: that was careless (of me)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧: absent-mindedly, by mistake; about a lapse of attention
- ⟦{軽率|けいそつ}→軽率：06866_keisotsu⟧: rash, hasty; about poor judgment
